### Supported facts
| Layer | Supported fact |
|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense context | The source is an Aerospace & Defense Test presentation by Randy Schnell, titled “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.” [3][63] |
| Market requirement | The listed mission / market drivers include tactical edge connectivity needs, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, complex RF environments and contested spectrum, growing private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, tactical private 5G networks on military bases, and secure command-and-control network demand. [8] |
| Threat model | Smart jamming is described as an adaptive RF jamming threat in mission-critical / military wireless communications. [50] |
| Resilience approach | The resilience problem is mapped to 5G handover signaling and 5G frequency-hopping / legacy FHSS behavior. [6][58] |
| Test-design parameter | The test design uses UE-reported supported bands and focuses on handover interruption intervals defined in 3GPP TS 38.300. [3][58] |
| Measurable outcomes | The sources identify handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS as measured quantities for the mitigation direction. [54] |
| Video / application reliability parameter | The presentation says throughput and WebRTC statistics supported video-call reliability, but it did not provide concrete throughput, jitter, packet loss, bandwidth, jammer profile, or modem values. [3][5] |
| Signaling tester capability facts | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD. [11][13] |
| Signaling / application capability facts | R&S CMX500 features include NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, and automation interfaces. [11] |
| Callbox workflow facts | The CMX500 callbox source positions it for quick call setup, RF testing, mobility testing, application testing, network slicing, IP throughput, security analysis, IMS services, power consumption, and speech quality. [24] |
| Non-signaling capability facts | The CMX500 callbox source says GPRF generator signal types include ARB, CW, Dual Tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF generator instances in parallel, and ARB Sequencer. [19] |
| Non-signaling RF capability facts | The CMX500 RF generator frequency range is 400 MHz to 8000 MHz with 0.1 Hz frequency resolution, 1000 MHz instantaneous bandwidth, and 250 MHz RF bandwidth. [16] |
| Non-signaling recording / replay fact | The IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte to a file and save files as `.wv` for replay. [19] |
| Limitation | The sources do not provide jammer waveform, jammer power, tracking delay, hop prediction capability, attack success rate, jammer dwell time, hop pattern, or statistical outcome values. [5][7][56] |
### Inferred chain map
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling Tester capability | Required Non-signaling Tester capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| 【推論】For resilient tactical/private 5G under smart jamming and EW, the measurable test focus should be inter-frequency handover behavior, especially handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS, because the sources map the mitigation to 5G handover / handover-frequency-hopping and identify those measurements. [6][8][54][58] | Handover interruption interval, RTT, iPerf throughput, WebRTC QoS. [54] | 5G NR network emulation with LTE / NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling, SA / NSA operation, mobility testing, IP throughput, and application testing. [11][13][24] | RF / GPRF generation for controlled RF stress using CW, ARB, Dual Tone, `.wv` replay, multiple generator instances, IQ record / replay, and RF generation across 400 MHz to 8000 MHz. [16][19] |
| 【推論】For maintaining command-and-control or video-like mission applications under contested RF conditions, the measurable parameters should include throughput and WebRTC statistics, because the source uses those to support video-call reliability but notes that concrete jitter, packet loss, latency, and bandwidth values are absent. [3][5][8] | Throughput and WebRTC statistics; numeric jitter, packet loss, latency, and bandwidth are not provided. [3][5] | Application testing, IP traffic analysis, throughput measurement, and callbox workflows for quick call setup and application testing. [11][24] | Non-signaling impairment / interferer generation can be approached with GPRF ARB, CW, Dual Tone, replay `.wv`, and AWGN-related waveform libraries, but the sources do not specify a validated smart-jammer waveform or profile. [19][56] |
| 【推論】For frequency-agile operation using UE-supported bands, the measurable parameter chain should include UE capability / supported-band handling and carrier-frequency changes, because the source says the test design uses UE capabilities and maps resilience to 5G handover plus frequency-hopping behavior. [3][58] | UE-reported supported bands and handover interruption intervals. [3][58] | NR signaling support and network-emulation capability across NR FR1 / NR FR2, with mobility testing workflows. [11][13][24] | Frequency-agile RF generation requires frequency coverage and resolution; the cited CMX500 RF generator supports 400 MHz to 8000 MHz with 0.1 Hz resolution. [16] |

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[DUT]]：來源明確以 unmodified 5G DUT 為限制條件；技術方法必須放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration，而不是修改 DUT 本身。
- 與 [[R&S CMX500]]：既有頁面整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 Radio Communication Tester、NR / LTE / WLAN signaling、fading、application test 與 automation 平台。本來源只提到 CMX customers 與 5G test setup，沒有明示硬體型號、option 或配置，因此不能把測試結果歸因為正式 CMX500 規格或能力。
- 與 [[Beamforming]]：來源 roadmap 提到 2025–2028 mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；這可作為 [[Beamforming]] / [[相控陣列天線]] 待讀資料線索，但不提供 beamforming 技術定義或量測方法。
- 與 [[Counter-UAV 技術]]：來源 mid-term roadmap 提到 early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection & perimeter defense；這與 counter-UAV sensing 主題相鄰，但來源未提供 counter-UAV 系統、sensor spec 或效能數據。
- 與 [[5G NTN validation and testing]]、[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：本來源處理 private / tactical 5G resilience 與 jamming，不是 NTN channel emulation 或 satellite validation；兩者都屬 contested / non-terrestrial / mission-critical 連線可靠性脈絡，但不可混用測試條件。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制
[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。

Smart Jamming › 來源中的定義與語境
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- mission context 包含 rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics。
- problem statement 指向 current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming。
- source problem question 是：是否能在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，使用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] capabilities 強化連線。
- outcome 語境稱，在 smart-jammer pressure 下，both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；但簡報沒有完整數值。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）提供更具體描述：newer, cheaper and more powerful [[RF]] equipment for consumer use, like [[SDR]] devices, can easily be converted into smart jammers；這些 devices can track the used frequency of the communications and transmit noise at specific moments to disrupt the communications while being difficult to track。

Smart Jamming › 與一般 jamming 的區分限制
目前來源可以支持以下敘述：

- smart jamming 與 [[SDR]] accessibility 相關；來源把 cheaper / more powerful consumer RF equipment 視為 threat enabler。
- smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency，而非只做固定頻率或寬頻干擾。
- smart jammer 在 specific moments 發射 noise，因此其 detection / tracking 較困難。

但來源仍沒有提供正式 taxonomy，不能區分其是否屬於 broadband noise jammer、spot jammer、swept jammer、protocol-aware jammer、reactive jammer 或 AI-assisted jammer。

Smart Jamming › 對 5G private networks 的影響
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 中的 operator expectation mismatch 是：operators expect commercial-grade throughput under adversarial conditions。也就是 private 5G / tactical edge 期待維持 throughput 與 video-call reliability，但 smart jamming / [[EW]] 使連線服務連續性變成問題。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 則把影響放在 mission-critical use cases：emergencies、disasters、military operations、essential public services 與 potentially NATO / DoD public-private 5G networks。來源強調 reliability is of upmost importance and should not be compromised in such an accessible way。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是本概念在 private 5G / tactical network 場景下的主頁。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]] 是目前來源中最具體的 mitigation implementation。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 中的 [[RF Jammers]]、[[GPS Spoofers]] 與 detection / neutralization 技術同樣屬 contested RF / countermeasure 脈絡，但 [[Counter UAV tech]] 未描述 5G smart jamming。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 與 [[UAV 通訊頻段]] 涉及 UAV C2 / telemetry / payload links；不可由 UAV 頻段表推論 smart jammer 的 5G 攻擊頻段。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 使用限制
- 不可把本來源解讀為 3GPP 已標準化某種 5G FHSS anti-jam waveform。
- 不可由 legacy FH capabilities 推論具體 tactical radio、SINCGARS / SRW 實作或 [[R&S CMX500]] option。
- 不可把 video-call outcome 當作所有 smart-jamming 情境的保證；簡報本身說 this does not mean invulnerability。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 是 Market white paper，不是 binding product specifications；頁尾寫明 data without tolerance limits is not binding。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 5G handover 的映射
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把方法映射到：

- [[5G Handover]] signaling procedure；
- 5G frequency-hopping / frequency agility behavior；
- UE-reported band support；
- [[HO interruption interval]]，並標註 message definitions / intervals per [[3GPP TS 38.300]]。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 進一步說明：5G operates on a fixed frequency for each cell；雖然已有 limited form of frequency hopping，但它 confined to the cell bandwidth and resource block allocation。白皮書提出利用 inter-frequency handover 在不同 cells / carriers 間切換，讓 5G 表現得像 frequency hopping。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 FHSS 的關係
兩份來源都使用 legacy FH capabilities、frequency-hopping、FHSS、frequency-agile operation 等語彙。本頁不把它們裁決為同一技術實作：

- [[FHSS]] 在簡報中主要出現在 defense program table。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實作是 handover-based inter-frequency carrier switching。
- 白皮書沒有提供 hop sequence、spreading code、synchronization、dwell time、jammer reacquisition time 或 PHY-layer FH waveform details。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › Defense program context
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出多個 FHSS / 5G integration examples：

| Program / effort | 來源中的 FHSS role | 來源中的 5G integration |
|---|---|---|
| [[5G.MIL]] | LPX LPI/LPD waveform，FH-type | Hybrid 5G + tactical waveform switching |
| [[Raytheon OXYGEN]] | Tactical MANET needing FHSS anti-jam | 5G sidelink extended to tactical radios |
| [[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]] | FHSS tactical radios such as SINCGARS / HQ / SRW | SDRs + 5G gateways integration |
| [[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] | FH agile operation for contested EW | 5G included in EMS-aware backbone |
| [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing | Freq-agile operation for shared spectrum | 5G / 6G coexistence in contested bands |

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

- 簡報將測試階段分為 [[Go-NoGo Testing]]、[[Non-Sig Testing]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 與 [[R&D Testing]]，並以 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox 作為可快速建立 call、進行 RF testing、mobility testing 與 application testing 的平台。
- Callbox focus 包含 [[RF Testing]]、[[3GPP pre-conformance]]、[[Mobility Testing]]、[[Application Testing]]、[[Network Slicing]]、[[IP Throughput]]、[[Security Analysis]]、[[Backend Service]]、[[IMS Services]]、[[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]、[[ATSSS]]、[[Power Consumption]]、[[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]、[[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]] 與 [[Speech Quality]]。
- 來源描述 [[CMsquares]] 為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI 的介面，並列出 live views、app testing、NTN live views、sequencer、log analysis 與 one-click RF testing。
- [[RF SA Preconformance]] 部分宣稱可在 GUI 中快速開始 manual 3GPP RF pre-conformance，並提到 automatic configuration of parameters per TC、25 TCs、dynamic workspace per TC、NR-NTN / NSA / LTE coming、release 時有 comprehensive App Note，連結為 `https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/1C111`。

- R&D automation / RF pathloss calibration 部分描述 predefined blocks、mix & match、PL from signaling measurements + reports、GPRF measurements 與 NRP Power Meter；來源 notes 稱 NRP slightly more precise、GPRF 會包含 connector + additional RF path、golden device 最容易但 least precise。

Smart Jamming
[[Smart Jamming]] 是 mission-critical / military wireless communications 中的 adaptive RF jamming threat；目前來源把它描述為能追蹤通訊頻率、在特定時刻發射 noise、造成 service disruption 且 difficult to detect 的攻擊方式。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 5G handover 的映射
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把方法映射到：

- [[5G Handover]] signaling procedure；
- 5G frequency-hopping / frequency agility behavior；
- UE-reported band support；
- [[HO interruption interval]]，並標註 message definitions / intervals per [[3GPP TS 38.300]]。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 進一步說明：5G operates on a fixed frequency for each cell；雖然已有 limited form of frequency hopping，但它 confined to the cell bandwidth and resource block allocation。白皮書提出利用 inter-frequency handover 在不同 cells / carriers 間切換，讓 5G 表現得像 frequency hopping。
